user_request: My training needs about 60 hours, but the job is killed after 24 hours. How do I make it continue automatically?
context: boost_usr_prod, normal QOS, the script saves a checkpoint every 2,000 steps.
expected_answer: 24 h is the limit of boost_usr_prod with the normal QOS. If the job needs at most 8 nodes, the simplest fix is --qos=boost_qos_lprod (up to 4 days, max 8 nodes per account; expect a longer wait). Otherwise split the run into chained jobs: the script resumes from the last checkpoint at start; submit the next job with --dependency=afterany:<previous id> (or a loop of sbatch --dependency=singleton with the same job name). Ask Slurm for a signal before the time limit (--signal=B:USR1@600), trap it in the batch script and write a checkpoint, so less than one checkpoint interval is lost. Checkpoints are needed in both cases, because a 60 h job can still fail.
must_not: set --time=60:00:00 on the normal QOS
restart from scratch in every job
